description: Provider-free live package skeleton for generic earnings-call transcript normalization contracts.

credentials.policy: No credentials are declared by this skeleton; live transcript vendors and HTTP cleaners belong only to future provider-specific packages behind explicit capability gates.

provider_gate.test_rule: package tests must pass with fixtures only, no credentials, no provider SDK imports, and no network I/O

field_canonicalization.speaker: trim role prefixes, collapse whitespace, preserve title/name when known
field_canonicalization.date: RFC3339 full-date corrected from fiscal period metadata when source date is stale or contradictory
field_canonicalization.fiscal_period: uppercase quarter plus four digit fiscal_year
field_canonicalization.provenance: every normalized segment carries source_id, source_line_start, source_line_end, and transform_notes
field_canonicalization.chunking: stable chunk_index ordered by source_line_start with token_estimate budget metadata

date_correction_policy.source_date_conflict_policy: prefer fiscal_calendar fixture when raw date conflicts with fiscal quarter

test_gates: manifest and referenced JSON files decode without external dependencies
fixtures prove speaker cleaning, date correction, fiscal quarter/year lookup, and segment provenance
chunk fixtures preserve segment boundaries, deterministic order, and max token-estimate budget
optional HTTP cleaner absence produces a clean skip instead of network access
normalizer remains independent of q/runtime and future live provider packages

no_built_in_guarantee.statement: Leia core does not provide earnings-call transcript vendors or transcript normalizers as built-ins; this package declares provider-free schemas and fixtures only.
